verified via Showdown source: onUpdate cures psn/tox on the spot, on top of the onSetStatus block above that only stops NEW infliction — relevant when this ability is gained mid-battle (Skill Swap, Trace, Mummy/Lingering Aroma, Entrainment) while already poisoned. Same onUpdate shape found on Insomnia and Limber in this batch; may be worth checking the rest of this family (Water Veil, Magma Armor, Own Tempo) too, out of this batch's scope.
